summary: When Nora's document has a typing error in it, she is now shown exactly where, and told to send it as an object and not to say it was made until it is saved. Before, a long document with one stray quote failed with a message she could not act on.
details: The document guidance she reads now says to send the document as an object, not as text.
limitations: If her final message is held back for linking a document that was never saved, the room still gets the generic apology rather than a sentence saying the document was not saved.
Her notes can still record a document as published after her own false claim.
